node.title: DSP8 smooth-trace substar router
node.statement: For a fixed product target and one representation parameter r, the nodal condition for a second parameter s is (1+r+s-t)^3=27rs, a cubic in s with leading coefficient one. Thus every fixed-target nodal edge graph has maximum degree at most three. The Pareto product stars consequently retain same-center smooth substars; at the preferred (P,R)>=(35,2) corner, the degree-eight/six stars contain degree-five/three smooth substars. Their nonzero trace discriminants may be used as saturation factors in the candidate ideals without losing an actual official survivor. This is structural compression, not a DSP8 moment or survivor bound.
